subject: Security/compliance discovery  next steps and SOC 2 roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security/compliance discovery  next steps and SOC 2 roadmap

Alex  thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on priorities and timeline: 

Recap:
- You highlighted FinCo's requirement for a recent third-party SOC 2 attestation (within 12 months) and confirmation of GDPR/HIPAA controls for customer data.
- You requested the vendor security questionnaire and an initial technical deep-dive with your GRC and engineering leads.

What we can share now:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II in May 2025; we have a redacted report and an executive summary attached for initial review. We run annual audits and expect the next Type II to complete in Q2 2026.
- GDPR/Privacy: We have a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and standard data handling controls; happy to surface specific processing locations and subprocessor list in the deep-dive.
- HIPAA/BAA: We can execute a Business Associate Agreement; we will need to confirm deployment options (Redwood hosted vs. private deployment) for scoping.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please complete and return the attached vendor questionnaire (FinCo_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). If easier, we can take the first run at it and share answers.
2) Schedule a technical/deep-dive with your GRC + engineering (suggested: Tue 17 Mar 10:00 AM PT).
3) Lauren (cc'd) will own evidence collection and follow-up items; Rishi will align on commercial expectations.

Attachments: FinCo_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (attached), SOC2-Type2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted)

Links: SOC2 summary folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSOC2

Happy to adjust please confirm preferred attendees for the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@finco.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:05:23 -0400
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery  next steps and SOC 2 roadmap

Marissa  thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) SOC 2 timing: our policy requires a third-party SOC 2 attestation within the last 12 months. You mentioned Type II in May 2025  can you confirm the coverage period and whether you have a letter from the auditor confirming re-performance or interim updates since then?

2) HIPAA / BAA: we will need an executed BAA before moving PII/PHI into any environment. Please advise whether Redwood already has a BAA template and what factors would affect signing (hosting mode, subcontractors).

3) ISO 27001 / FedRAMP: do you have a public roadmap or target quarters for ISMS certification or FedRAMP readiness? Our public sector team will want to see timelines.

I've attached our vendor requirements workbook (FinCo_Vendor_Requirements.xlsx)  if you could start populating the security controls section that would speed things up. Also cc'd Procurement for scheduling.

We can do Tue 17 Mar 10:00 AM PT for the technical deep-dive  I'll send a calendar invite when we finalize attendees. Long list on our side (GRC + cloud ops).

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Vendor Risk, FinCo Financial Services
alex.johnson@finco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery  next steps and SOC 2 roadmap

Alex  thanks, see inline below for quick answers and next steps. I'll have Lauren or Neha pick up the detailed questionnaire items.

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II with coverage period 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30. Auditor was BrightAudit; we have a redacted PDF (attached) and an auditor confirmation letter on request. We run annual attestations and are on-track for a 2026 Type II engagement (audit Q2 2026).

- GDPR: We have a DPA and standard contractual clauses where required. The SOC2 report includes our privacy control mappings; we will provide a separate data processing addendum and subprocessor list in the next packet. Link to SOC2 folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSOC2

- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood can sign a standard BAA. The main scoping variable is whether you need Redwood hosted (multi-tenant) vs. Dedicated/Private deployment. If PHI is involved we recommend Dedicated or Private for isolation  happy to work through details in the deep-dive.

- ISO 27001 / FedRAMP roadmap: ISO 27001 scoping and ISMS implementation work is planned for H2 2026 with a certification target in late 2027. FedRAMP / public sector readiness is exploratory for 2027+; we will share a more detailed roadmap when Product & Security finalize scope.

Proposed action items:
1) We'll start filling FinCo_Vendor_Requirements.xlsx and return the completed section by Tue 24 Mar.
2) Technical deep-dive: Tue 17 Mar 10:00 AM PT  recommended attendees from Redwood: Lauren (Security & Compliance), Neha (GRC Evidence Owner), and a member of Infrastructure for architecture questions.
3) Lauren will own evidence collection and will post artifacts to the SOC2 drive; we'll include a redacted SOC2 summary (attached).

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, SOC2-Type2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted)

Let me know if you want Redwood to start the questionnaire directly  we can pre-populate and send for your review.

Best,
Marissa

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery  next steps and SOC 2 roadmap

Alex / Marissa  I'll take point on the questionnaire and the evidence pack. Quick notes: 
- I'll start populating the FinCo_Vendor_Requirements.xlsx and post evidence to the shared SOC2 folder by Wed 24 Mar.
- Immediate items I need from infra: current production architecture diagram, list of subprocessors, and retention/location of logs. Neha  can you grab those and drop into the drive link?
- For HIPAA scoping, we should confirm which workloads would carry PHI so we can scope the BAA and any isolation requirements.

I'll be on the Tue 17 Mar deep-dive. If there are particular control areas you want us to prioritize (e.g., encryption key management, access reviews), list them in reply and we'll prep owners.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks  that works for us. I've confirmed attendees on our side (GRC lead, cloud ops, procurement) and added Emily Park from our public sector team. Calendar invite is coming; please accept when you get it: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finco-technical-deep-dive

We also need a BAA draft prior to any PHI discussion. Procurement will follow up with a DocuSign SOW link for the evaluation period: https://www.docusign.com/link/sow-finco
